name: Google Cloud Digital Leader

fee.note: USD list price plus tax where applicable. Every attempt is paid.

exam.format: 50–60 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 90 minutes, online-proctored or at a test center (Pearson VUE since March 2026). English, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese and French. No prerequisites; Google recommends experience collaborating with technical professionals.

scope: Cloud computing basics and how Google Cloud supports an organization: digital and data transformation, AI, infrastructure and application modernization, security, and cloud operations.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Google reports pass/fail only and does not publish a passing score.

Certified holders can renew in the last part of their validity with a shorter renewal exam (45 minutes, 20 questions, $60) or through designated courses and skill badges in Google Skills, which add one year.
The current exam guide is dated August 12, 2026; it covers both the standard and renewal exams.

access.retake: Up to ten attempts a year, with at least 14 days between failed attempts.
